Lemma
1. Lemma 1.20\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0015, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0016 ↗ hanlin:thm-green-identity The Green function is symmetric: $G(x,y)=G(y,x)$ for distinct $x,y\in \Omega $.
Proof

\sketch Apply Green’s identity to $G(x_1,\cdot )$ and $G(x_2,\cdot )$ on the domain with small balls about both poles removed. The outer boundary term is zero. Replacing each pole term by the normalized fundamental solution and letting the radii tend to zero gives $G(x_1,x_2)=G(x_2,x_1)$.

□
